title: finding(fields): a lookup option label renders the referenced object's `titleFormat` ABOVE its declared `nameField` (and above the field's own `displayField`) — the order objectui#9436's ruling C1 reverses on the record page
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat #1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from objectui#9436's dev stop report (`5820114435`, `out_of_scope_findings`, class b). The seat re-read the site on `origin/main` before filing. ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact

`recordToOption` in `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` labels a fetched lookup option in this order:

```
templated ??            // formatRecordTitle(record, <referenced object's titleFormat>)
record[displayField] ?? // the lookup FIELD's own displayField
unified ??              // the unified resolver (declared nameField, …)
…
```

⇒ When the referenced object declares both `nameField` and `titleFormat`, the option shows the rendered template. It does NOT show the declared name field, and it does not show the field's own `displayField` either.

## Contract

- `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, the `titleFormat` describe: 「[DEPRECATED → nameField (ADR-0079)] Render-only title template; the server cannot return or query it, and **an explicit nameField now takes precedence**.」
- objectui#9436's ruling (class-1 ruling `5657441402`, letter C1, ratified `5814246926`, maintainer 「同意」): the declared pointer outranks `titleFormat`. The record page (the header, the `record:details` dedupe, `DetailView`) is being moved to that order under objectui#9436. Lookup options are a separate surface, with their own pins, and the ruling does not name them.

## Seam

`spec:ObjectSchema.titleFormat` / `spec:ObjectSchema.nameField` → `renderer:LookupField recordToOption` (option label).

## ⛔ Not claimed

- ⛔ This was not probed at runtime. It is a code reading at `origin/main`.
- ⛔ The fix and the place of `displayField` are not chosen. The field-level `displayField` is an explicit per-field choice, and whether it should outrank the object's declared pointer is part of the answer. The record-page order from objectui#9436 is the reference.
- ⛔ `LookupField.tsx` is currently held by objectui#10223 (another seat). Serialise behind it.

## Dedupe words

`recordToOption titleFormat` · `lookup label titleFormat nameField` · `ADR-0079 lookup option precedence` · `lookup option template outranks nameField`
